title: angelica acutiloba
intro: Angelica acutiloba, commonly known as Korean angelica or Dong quai, is a perennial plant native to East Asia, belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and alleviating menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with menopause. The therapeutic actions of Angelica acutiloba include its ability to warm and invigorate the body, dispel cold and dampness, and promote blood flow. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ferulic acid, volatile oils, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
